caption:
This anime chase never slows down.
Seedance 2.5 animated every single frame.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. Aspect ratio 2.35:1 ultra-wide (992x432). Look: full-color 2.5D hand-drawn anime action film, rough oil-paint brushstroke backgrounds, three-value cel shading, light manga screentone, dry-brush speed lines; warm orange-pink sunset light with blue-cyan shadows and pink-purple reflections on wet asphalt. Camera feel: low, aggressive, hand-animated cinematography with whip pans and fast tracking, uneven hand-drawn timing (twos and threes on normal motion, ones on bursts). Pacing: very fast, 24 hard cuts, no slow-motion except the eye close-up. No glowing energy, no magic effects: all light comes from the sunset.

CHARACTERS:
- THE FIGHTER: slim young man, around 20, pale skin, choppy spiky white hair falling over his forehead, amber-gold eyes, a wide dark-red matte chevron-shaped band painted under both eyes across the cheeks and nose bridge, cocky restrained grin. Loose black hoodie with the hood down behind his neck, loose black pants, dark shoes. Bare-handed, always empty hands.
- THE SWORDSMAN: slim young man, around 20, pale skin, messy spiky black hair, sharp dark eyes, calm cold face. Open white haori-style robe with wide sleeves that flares like a cape, black inner kimono with a black collar strip down the chest, wide black hakama trousers, black fingerless gloves, wooden sandals with dark straps. One katana with a black-wrapped hilt and gold guard, black scabbard at his left hip.

LOCATION: a broken, empty elevated city expressway at sunset: cracked dark asphalt with old rail tracks embedded on the left, scattered rain puddles reflecting the pink sky, steel guardrails, massive gray concrete overpass pillars and a bridge deck overhead, a blue glass curtain-wall office block beside the road, warm-lit high-rise towers in the distance and a giant statue silhouette far on the skyline.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.5) — The chase. Low camera skimming the road, tracking backward at high speed. The fighter sprints toward camera at frame-left, big in foreground; the swordsman runs behind him at frame-right, smaller, white robe flaring, katana low in his hand. Rails, puddles and pillars streak past in fast parallax.
SHOT 2 (00:01.5-00:02.3) — Runaway car. Road-level shot down the centerline: an ordinary silver-gray sedan barrels toward camera out of control, bouncing on the cracked asphalt, growing from small to filling the frame; camera pushes forward into it.
SHOT 3 (00:02.3-00:03.4) — The vault. Side-on lateral tracking shot, glass building behind: the fighter launches off the asphalt and dives up over the sedan's hood; the swordsman slide-steps low past the car's side, katana held in front of his body, robe sweeping.
SHOT 4 (00:03.4-00:03.9) — Inverted. Camera whips up to the sky: the fighter hangs fully upside down high above, small against blue sky with pink clouds, hoodie and pant cuffs whipping.
SHOT 5 (00:03.9-00:04.8) — Upside-down grin. Fast push-in to an upside-down close-up of the fighter's face against the sky: white hair hanging down, dark-red under-eye band, amber eyes, a dangerous smile.
SHOT 6 (00:04.8-00:05.8) — Fist from above. Over-the-shoulder from behind the swordsman (white robe, black hair in foreground right), looking up: the inverted fighter drops at him; the swordsman raises the katana; the fighter's fist punches down toward the lens, huge foreshortened.
SHOT 7 (00:05.8-00:06.2) — Hand plant. Close on the sedan roof: the fighter plants both hands on the roof, body upside down above it.
SHOT 8 (00:06.2-00:06.9) — Tuck. The fighter tucks into a tight black ball and rolls over the car roof, overpass pillar and sunset towers behind.
SHOT 9 (00:06.9-00:08.1) — The flip. Locked-off low shot by a concrete pillar and guardrail: the sedan flips upside down through frame, scraping the road in a burst of orange sparks; its dark underside swings past the lens.
SHOT 10 (00:08.1-00:08.8) — Tumbling car. Wide down the road: the sedan cartwheels in mid-air toward the distant towers, a white-robed figure riding its flank.
SHOT 11 (00:08.8-00:09.5) — Leap past the overpass. Extreme low angle up at the underside of the bridge deck: the swordsman leaps across the sky above it, white robe spread like wings.
SHOT 12 (00:09.5-00:09.9) — Landing. Low ground shot from behind: the swordsman's sandal and black hakama land on the wet asphalt between puddles.
SHOT 13 (00:09.9-00:10.6) — Blade past the grin. Medium close: the fighter in foreground left, eyes half-closed, smiling, as the swordsman's katana slices past just in front of his face from frame-right.
SHOT 14 (00:10.6-00:13.5) — The duel. Medium-wide, side view, glass curtain wall and guardrail behind: the swordsman lunges and slashes again and again; the fighter sways, sidesteps and ducks with hands open, never touching the blade.
SHOT 15 (00:13.5-00:16.7) — Thrust and dodge. Tighter two-shot: a straight thrust passes beside the fighter's head; he ducks under, rises; the swordsman lifts the katana vertical, then a horizontal slash streaks across frame as a white motion smear; the fighter leans back and raises a knee.
SHOT 16 (00:16.7-00:17.5) — Along the blade. Over the swordsman's outstretched gloved arm: the katana points straight at the fighter, who stands at the tip, unbothered; slow push in along the blade.
SHOT 17 (00:17.5-00:18.6) — Caught. Close-up: the fighter pinches the flat of the steel blade between bare fingers, grinning at camera, hood shadowing his neck; gold guard and the swordsman's black glove at frame-left.
SHOT 18 (00:18.6-00:20.8) — The eyes. MUST SHOW: extreme close-up filling the frame with only the fighter's two amber-gold eyes, white hair strands over them and the dark-red chevron band beneath; very slow push-in, the eyes narrow slightly. Held still, almost silent.
SHOT 19 (00:20.8-00:21.3) — Spin kick. Smeared fast frame: the fighter spins a black blur of a kick into the swordsman, who recoils, robe flying.
SHOT 20 (00:21.3-00:22.3) — Under the overpass. Low wide under the bridge deck: the fighter lands in a crouch in foreground left, hand on the asphalt; the swordsman slides to a stop in the background, then stands, katana drawn sideways.
SHOT 21 (00:22.3-00:24.7) — Puddle charge. Wide on the rail-track road: both charge each other, feet smashing through puddles in big hand-drawn water splashes; they clash, spin and keep running side by side.
SHOT 22 (00:24.7-00:25.7) — Pillar impact. Camera tight on the gray concrete of a bridge pillar, sunset sky beside it; MUST SHOW: a sudden impact crater cracks across the concrete surface with spidering cracks, dust and chips flying.
SHOT 23 (00:25.7-00:27.6) — Up the pillar. High wide angle down the road: two tiny figures race toward a massive pillar and run straight up its face, leaping off the edge of the expressway.
SHOT 24 (00:27.6-00:30.1) — Midair clash. Wide side view in mid-air, huge sunset skyline and the bridge deck at frame-right: both fly at each other; the fighter throws a punch, the swordsman parries with the katana; they twist and flip past each other, the swordsman's white robe billowing open like a cape as both somersault downward. End on the frame of both mid-flip.

SOUND: high-speed electronic drums and distorted bass instrumental building the whole way; tire screech and engine roar in shots 2-3; metal scrape and sparks crackle on the flip; whoosh and steel swish on every slash; water splashes in shot 21; a deep concrete crack in shot 22. Music drops to a low hum with only breathing in shot 18, then slams back. No dialogue.
prompt_short: 2.5D hand-drawn anime, 2.35:1, sunset broken expressway. White-haired bare-handed fighter vaults a runaway car, flips it, dodges a white-robed swordsman's katana, catches the blade; eye close-up; midair clash. Fast low tracking, whip pans, electronic drums.
